FlowerPainter.UI.Area.HowDraw: Click corners, then the first one

FlowerPainter.UI.Arrangement.Hint: Repeats in this order along the edges
FlowerPainter.UI.Building.Title: Building…
FlowerPainter.UI.Feature.NoRoom: No room for it in this area.
FlowerPainter.UI.Fit.NoRoomHint: Make the area bigger or turn other extras off.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.DirectTip: The template keeps its proportions. Set the width and click Place a flag.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.DragTip: Hold and drag the flag to move it. Release to confirm; right-click or Esc cancels.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.PlaceHint: Click the ground to place a flag.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.RecommendedSize: Suggested size at this flower spacing: {0} × {1} m or larger
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.Search: Search flags by name or code
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.SizeTip: Smaller flags can still be planted, but stars, lettering and emblems may lose detail. This is a visual guide, not a hard limit.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flags.Title: Flags

FlowerPainter.UI.Flowers.PartitionFillTi: Choose flowers and click a subdivision. The hovered subdivision is outlined. Unfilled subdivisions stay empty; boundaries do not plant ribbons.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flowers.Preview: Real flowers update after edits. Only the part inside your frame is planted.
FlowerPainter.UI.Flowers.RegionTip: Choose a fill and flower, then click an empty region on the map. Inside and outside a circle can use different fills.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.Colors: Image colours are matched to flower colours. Transparent areas stay empty. Density controls the number of small flowers.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.DragTip: Hold and drag the flowers to move them. Right-click or Esc cancels. Edit a built group to adjust it again.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.Failed: Import failed. Check the format and try another image.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.Formats: PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, ICO, EMF, WMF. Animated images use the first frame.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.PlaceHint: Click the ground to place the flower design.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.Preview: Place the design directly, then drag, rotate or resize it. Proportions stay fixed.
FlowerPainter.UI.Images.Title: Image flowers
FlowerPainter.UI.Info.Missing: Some assets it used are missing (a mod or asset pack was removed). Edit to replace them.
FlowerPainter.UI.Info.Modified: Changed with other tools since it was built. Editing rebuilds it from its design.
FlowerPainter.UI.LauncherTip: Choose an area and turn it into a park, plaza, parking lot, streets… or your own mix.
FlowerPainter.UI.Legend.AllTip: Show every layer as it was
FlowerPainter.UI.Legend.RowTip: Hover: show only this on the map. Click: hide it.
FlowerPainter.UI.Legend.RowTipHidden: Hidden on the map. Click to show it.
FlowerPainter.UI.LockedHint: Click to let Randomize change it again.
FlowerPainter.UI.Make.Title: Pick what to make
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.CantEdit: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.DissolveText: Keep all roads, plants and facilities. Release this area for new selections. Its pieces can be edited individually, but the group cannot be restored.
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.DissolveTip: Keep the built elements and release the area for new selections.
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.Hover: Click something you built to edit it
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.RemoveText: Everything FlowerPainter built here (paths, surfaces, objects, roads it added) is bulldozed. Buildings that grew next to it stay.
FlowerPainter.UI.Manage.Title: Built with FlowerPainter
FlowerPainter.UI.Marker.AlleyTip: A small road junction through the edge.
FlowerPainter.UI.Marker.TwoWayTip: Cars drive in and out here.
FlowerPainter.UI.Markers.BannerFor: Placing {0} — click on the outline. Right-click one to remove it.
FlowerPainter.UI.Markers.BannerHint: Click the outline by a road · right-click removes
FlowerPainter.UI.Markers.Hint: Click the outline to add; right-click one to remove.
FlowerPainter.UI.Markers.Note: Pick a type, then click the outline by a road.
FlowerPainter.UI.Mock.Timeout: Planning took too long and was stopped.
FlowerPainter.UI.MoveTip: Drag to move. Double-click to dock.
FlowerPainter.UI.NoSettings: No settings: adapts to the area.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Applied.Tip: The game uses this value for the build.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Attractivenes: Draws tourists: adds to your city's tourism attractiveness.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Capacity.Mean: How many nearby streets the park can serve before it gets crowded.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Entertainment: Wellbeing boost for residents within reach.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.KeepVanilla.T: Keeps every value inside what vanilla parks of a similar size use.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Leisure.Meani: How much fun one visit gives a citizen looking for something to do.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.NoRoad: No road edge: only tourism applies.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Note: Only attractiveness reaches the game here. The others are saved with the build.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.NoteCompanion: A small hidden park building at the road edge carries these stats, like a vanilla park.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Outside: Some values are beyond what vanilla parks this size have; the city may feel unbalanced.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Range.Meaning: How far residents walk to enjoy the park (path cost, about metres).
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Shown.Tip: Needs the companion park building (road edge and setting); saved with the build.
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Title: Park stats
FlowerPainter.UI.ParkStats.Upkeep.Meanin: Monthly running cost a vanilla park this good would have.
FlowerPainter.UI.Partitions.OwnSettings: These props and this style apply only to the selected region. Press Fill region to apply.
FlowerPainter.UI.Partitions.SelectFirst: Select a region to choose its props and fill style.
FlowerPainter.UI.Partitions.SelectTip: Click a region on the map or in the list. Selecting it does not plant flowers.
FlowerPainter.UI.Patches.SpacingTip: Smaller blossom spacing makes finer, smaller flowers. Higher flower density adds more flowers at the same size and costs more performance.
FlowerPainter.UI.Picker.HoverHint: Hover to preview, click to use
FlowerPainter.UI.Places.Title: Places inside
FlowerPainter.UI.Plan.Changed: Design changed. Start planning to update the map and estimate.
FlowerPainter.UI.Plan.First: Start planning to preview this design on the map.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.CantSave: This style can't be saved over
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.DeleteText: Your style is removed. Builds stay as they are.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.ExportNote: Saved. Send this file to share your styles.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.ResetText: Your changes to this style are dropped.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.SaveAsTip: Save these settings as a new style
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.SaveBuiltIn: Save over this style (reset any time)
FlowerPainter.UI.Preset.SaveDefaultNo: Default can't be changed. Save as a new style.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preview.RealTip: See-through game models and textures, exactly what will be built.
FlowerPainter.UI.Preview.SketchTip: Fast outlines and dots. Best while drawing and trying things.
FlowerPainter.UI.ResizeHeightTip: Drag to make it taller or shorter. Double-click for full height.
FlowerPainter.UI.ResizeTip: Drag to make it wider or narrower. Double-click for the default width.
FlowerPainter.UI.Review.ManualPlan: Finish your setup, then click Start planning.
FlowerPainter.UI.Review.PaintOnly: Ground paint stays when the build is removed.
FlowerPainter.UI.Review.PermanentStays: Removing this build will not undo the changes shown above.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.BlockTip2: A stroke stays in what the Paint bucket would fill where it started.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.BuildsTip: Keep off what you built with FlowerPainter.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ForceTip: Ignore all selection stops. Existing buildings stay protected during construction.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.GapTip: Openings narrower than this count as closed, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.LotsTip2: Keep off other lots (other mods, extractors).
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ReachTip: How far the fill may spread from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.RoadsTip2: Stop at the curb of every road, its junctions and turning circles.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.SmartTip: On: the brush stops at what you tick below. Off: it paints over everything.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.SmoothTip: How smooth the painted edge is.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.SnapTip: Pulls painted edges this close onto a curb.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.StopsTip: What the area never covers, for every tool. Red on the map.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ZoningBuiltTip: Keep off zoned cells that have a building.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ZoningGridTip: Keep off the whole zone grid along the streets, even cells nobody zoned.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ZoningTip: How much of the zoning the area keeps off.
FlowerPainter.UI.Rules.ZoningZonedTip: Keep off every zoned cell, built on or not.
FlowerPainter.UI.Tool.BucketTip2: Click to fill the land up to what it stops at. Shift+click adds more, right-click drops one.
FlowerPainter.UI.Tool.PaintTip: Brush the area on. Right-click erases.
FlowerPainter.UI.Tool.PointsTip2: Click corners, then the first one to close. Snaps to curbs, right angles and road nodes: two corners on road nodes follow the road between them.
FlowerPainter.UI.Version.Mismatch: Restart the game: FlowerPainter's files were updated while it was running.
FlowerPainter.UI.Walls.TracksTip: Train and tram tracks on the ground.
FlowerPainter.UI.Why.NotNow: Not available with the current settings
FlowerPainter.UI.Why.RestartForMode: Restart the game to use this: FlowerPainter was updated while the game was running.
